# Third-Party Capability References

This project contains no source code, vendored package, browser selector, or documentation text from the optional backends below. Their public interfaces informed only the capability-adapter boundary.

| Project | Relationship | Upstream license observed 2026-08-30 |
|---|---|---|
| [codex-chatgpt-control](https://github.com/adamallcock/codex-chatgpt-control) | Optional visible Chat/Work bridge | [MIT](https://github.com/adamallcock/codex-chatgpt-control/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [Oracle](https://github.com/steipete/oracle) | Optional browser/session and context-bundling adapter | [MIT](https://github.com/steipete/oracle/blob/main/LICENSE) |
| [Agentify Desktop](https://github.com/agentify-sh/desktop) | Optional user-managed AI web-tab MCP adapter | [MPL-2.0](https://github.com/agentify-sh/desktop/blob/main/LICENSE) |

These projects are independent and unofficial. Their inclusion in this list is neither affiliation nor endorsement. Users who install or distribute an optional backend must review that backend's current license, notices, security model, and provider terms directly.

Because no third-party code is copied or distributed here, the optional backends do not currently impose their source-license terms on this candidate. Reassess before vendoring, modifying, or distributing any adapter code.
